   6: import hashlib

  10: from win32_worker_connection import FileIdentity, ReadSet, _absolute_local_path

  12: NAMES = ("config.json", "model.bin", "preprocessor_config.json", "tokenizer.json", "vocabulary.json")
  13: GENERATED = MappingProxyType({name: ("Uoink generated adoption fixture: " + name + ". No model data.\n").encode("ascii")
  14:                               for name in NAMES})
  15: PAYLOAD_BYTES = sum(len(value) for value in GENERATED.values())
  16: FORMAT = "uoink.generated-inherited-readset.v1"
  17: ADMITTED_FORMAT = "uoink.admitted-inherited-readset.v1"
  18: CASES = frozenset(("positive", "wrong_identity"))

  21: class AdoptionRefusal(RuntimeError):
  22:     pass

  24: 
  25: def _require(condition, reason):

  30: def _canonical(value):
  31:     return json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=True,
  32:                       allow_nan=False).encode("ascii")

  34: 
  35: def namespace_digest():
  36:     rows = [[name, len(GENERATED[name]), hashlib.sha256(GENERATED[name]).hexdigest()] for name in NAMES]
  37:     return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(rows, separators=(",", ":")).encode("ascii")).hexdigest()

  40: def manifest_digest(payload):
  41:     return hashlib.sha256(_canonical(payload)).hexdigest()

  44: def fixed_paths(root):
  45:     _absolute_local_path(root)  # Lexical only; no resolve/stat/open.
  46:     _require(not root.endswith("\\"), "fixed_generated_directory_required")
  47:     return tuple(_absolute_local_path(root + "\\" + name) for name in NAMES)

  50: def _identity_row(identity):
  51:     _require(type(identity) is FileIdentity, "exact_file_identity_type")
  52:     return {"final_path": identity.final_path, "volume_serial": identity.volume_serial,
  53:             "file_id": identity.file_id.hex(), "size": identity.size,
  54:             "links": identity.links, "directory": identity.directory}

  57: def controller_manifest(primitives, read_set, worker, root, case):
  58:     """Called serially before child resume by the actual lifecycle start port."""
  59:     paths = fixed_paths(root)
  60:     _require(case in CASES and type(case) is str, "fixed_generated_case")
  61:     _require(any(item is read_set for item in primitives.read_sets)
  62:              and any(item is worker for item in primitives.workers)
  63:              and worker.read_set is read_set and worker.assigned and not worker.resumed
  64:              and not worker.unconfirmed and not read_set.unconfirmed and not read_set.released,
  65:              "exact_suspended_owned_worker_required")
  66:     _require(len(read_set.members) == len(read_set.identities) == len(worker.child_read_handles) == 5
  67:              and all(handle.closed for handle in worker.inherited_copies), "exact_inheritance_membership")
  68:     rows = []
  69:     for index, name in enumerate(NAMES):
  70:         handle, expected = read_set.members[index], read_set.identities[index]
  71:         primitives._owned(handle)
  72:         _require(primitives.identity(handle) == expected, "parent_guard_identity_changed")
  73:         row = {"name": name, "handle": worker.child_read_handles[index],
  74:                "identity": _identity_row(expected), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(GENERATED[name]).hexdigest()}
  75:         rows.append(row)
  76:     if case == "wrong_identity":
  77:         # The complete authenticated negative manifest deliberately binds the
  78:         # wrong first file ID. No message tampering or invalid MAC is simulated.
  79:         altered = bytearray.fromhex(rows[0]["identity"]["file_id"])
  80:         altered[0] ^= 1
  81:         rows[0]["identity"]["file_id"] = bytes(altered).hex()
  82:     payload = {"schema": FORMAT, "case": case, "namespace_sha256": namespace_digest(), "members": rows}
  83:     validate_manifest(payload, root, case, worker.child_control_handle, manifest_digest(payload))
  84:     return payload

  87: def validate_manifest(payload, root, case, control_value, expected_manifest_sha256):
  88:     """Validate the entire authenticated passive message before handle calls."""
  89:     paths = fixed_paths(root)
  90:     _require(type(payload) is dict and set(payload) == {"schema", "case", "namespace_sha256", "members"},
  91:              "adoption_manifest_shape")
  92:     _require(type(case) is str and case in CASES and payload["schema"] == FORMAT
  93:              and payload["case"] == case and payload["namespace_sha256"] == namespace_digest(),
  94:              "fixed_adoption_scope")
  95:     rows = payload["members"]
  96:     _require(type(rows) is list and len(rows) == 5, "five_ordered_generated_members")
  97:     _require(type(control_value) is int and 0 < control_value < (1 << 64) - 1, "fixed_control_handle")
  98:     values, validated = set(), []
  99:     for index, row in enumerate(rows):
 100:         _require(type(row) is dict and set(row) == {"name", "handle", "identity", "sha256"}, "member_shape")
 101:         name, value, identity = row["name"], row["handle"], row["identity"]
 102:         _require(type(name) is str and name == NAMES[index], "member_order_and_name")
 103:         _require(type(value) is int and 0 < value < (1 << 64) - 1 and value != control_value
 104:                  and value not in values, "unique_inherited_file_handle")
 105:         values.add(value)
 106:         _require(type(row["sha256"]) is str and row["sha256"] == hashlib.sha256(GENERATED[name]).hexdigest(),
 107:                  "generated_member_digest")
 108:         _require(type(identity) is dict and set(identity) == {"final_path", "volume_serial", "file_id", "size", "links", "directory"},
 109:                  "complete_file_identity")
 110:         final_path = identity["final_path"]
 111:         # GetFinalPathNameByHandleW(flags=0) returns this fixed extended DOS
 112:         # spelling. Compare lexically; never follow a path supplied by a frame.
 113:         _require(type(final_path) is str and len(final_path) <= 4096
 114:                  and final_path.casefold() == ("\\\\?\\" + paths[index]).casefold(), "fixed_generated_final_path")
 115:         _require(type(identity["volume_serial"]) is int and 0 <= identity["volume_serial"] < 1 << 64,
 116:                  "volume_serial_bound")
 117:         file_id = identity["file_id"]
 118:         _require(type(file_id) is str and len(file_id) == 32 and all(char in "0123456789abcdef" for char in file_id),
 119:                  "file_id_shape")
 120:         _require(type(identity["size"]) is int and identity["size"] == len(GENERATED[name])
 121:                  and type(identity["links"]) is int and identity["links"] == 1
 122:                  and identity["directory"] is False, "generated_file_shape")
 123:         expected = FileIdentity(final_path, identity["volume_serial"], bytes.fromhex(file_id),
 124:                                 identity["size"], 1, False)
 125:         validated.append((name, value, expected, row["sha256"]))
 126:     _require(type(expected_manifest_sha256) is str and len(expected_manifest_sha256) == 64
 127:              and manifest_digest(payload) == expected_manifest_sha256, "authenticated_manifest_binding")
 128:     return tuple(validated)

 174:     binding = [[asset.name, asset.size, asset.sha256] for asset in sorted(selected_model.assets, key=lambda item: item.name)]
 175:     expected_ns_sha = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(binding, separators=(",", ":")).encode("ascii")).hexdigest()
 176:     _require(type(payload["namespace_sha256"]) is str and payload["namespace_sha256"] == expected_ns_sha,

 181: class InheritedReadSetAdoption:
 182:     """One worker-local operation, owned by the fixed serial child flow.
 183: 
 184:     Refused owners are kept until that child exits. No arbitrary recovery or
 185:     real namespace capability can be obtained by toggling a field here.
 186:     """
 187: 
 188:     def __init__(self, primitives):
 189:         self.primitives = primitives
 190:         self.read_set = None
 191:         self.assets = None
 192:         self.namespace = None
 193:         self.inheritance_cleared = 0
 194:         self.identities_checked = 0
 195:         self.observed_identities = []
 196:         self.materialization_started = False
 197:         self.status = "new"
 198: 
 199:     def adopt(self, authenticated_payload, root, case, control_value, manifest_sha256):
 200:         _require(self.status == "new" and self.read_set is None, "single_adoption_attempt")
 201:         self.status = "validating"
 202:         try:
 203:             rows = validate_manifest(authenticated_payload, root, case, control_value, manifest_sha256)
 204:             _require(not any(not handle.closed and handle.value in {row[1] for row in rows}
 205:                              for handle in self.primitives.handles), "inherited_handle_already_owned")
 206:             read_set = ReadSet()
 207:             self.read_set = read_set
 208:             self.primitives.read_sets.append(read_set)
 209:             # All partial owners precede inheritance and identity queries. The
 210:             # control endpoint is already separately owned, and cannot overlap.
 211:             for name, value, expected, digest in rows:
 212:                 read_set.members.append(self.primitives._retain(value, "adopted-generated-member"))
 213:             ffi = self.primitives.api.ffi
 214:             for handle in read_set.members:
 215:                 flags = ffi.c_uint32()
 216:                 self.primitives.api.checked("GetHandleInformation", self.primitives._owned(handle), ffi.byref(flags))
 217:                 _require(flags.value == 1, "exact_inherited_handle_flag_required")
 218:                 self.primitives.api.checked("SetHandleInformation", self.primitives._owned(handle), 1, 0)
 219:                 self.primitives.api.checked("GetHandleInformation", self.primitives._owned(handle), ffi.byref(flags))
 220:                 _require(flags.value == 0, "inherited_flag_not_cleared")
 221:                 self.inheritance_cleared += 1
 222:             for handle, row in zip(read_set.members, rows):
 223:                 actual = self.primitives.identity(handle)
 224:                 self.identities_checked += 1
 225:                 self.observed_identities.append(_identity_row(actual))
 226:                 _require(actual == row[2], "inherited_file_identity_mismatch")
 227:                 read_set.identities.append(actual)
 228:             self.assets = tuple(BufferAsset(row[0], row[2].size, row[3], handle)
 229:                                 for handle, row in zip(read_set.members, rows))
 230:             self.status = "adopted"
 231:             return self
 232:         except BaseException:
 233:             self.status = "refused"
 234:             if self.read_set is not None:
 235:                 self.read_set.unconfirmed = True
 236:             raise
 237: 
 238:     def adopt_admitted(self, authenticated_payload, selected_model, control_value, manifest_sha256, root=None):
 239:         _require(self.status == "new" and self.read_set is None, "single_adoption_attempt")
 240:         self.status = "validating"
 241:         try:
 242:             rows = validate_admitted_manifest(authenticated_payload, selected_model, control_value, manifest_sha256, root)
 243:             _require(not any(not handle.closed and handle.value in {row[1] for row in rows}
 244:                              for handle in self.primitives.handles), "inherited_handle_already_owned")
 245:             read_set = ReadSet()
 246:             self.read_set = read_set
 247:             self.primitives.read_sets.append(read_set)
 248:             for name, value, expected, digest, size in rows:
 249:                 read_set.members.append(self.primitives._retain(value, "adopted-admitted-member"))
 250:             ffi = self.primitives.api.ffi
 251:             for handle in read_set.members:
 252:                 flags = ffi.c_uint32()
 253:                 self.primitives.api.checked("GetHandleInformation", self.primitives._owned(handle), ffi.byref(flags))
 254:                 _require(flags.value == 1, "exact_inherited_handle_flag_required")
 255:                 self.primitives.api.checked("SetHandleInformation", self.primitives._owned(handle), 1, 0)
 256:                 self.primitives.api.checked("GetHandleInformation", self.primitives._owned(handle), ffi.byref(flags))
 257:                 _require(flags.value == 0, "inherited_flag_not_cleared")
 258:                 self.inheritance_cleared += 1
 259:             for handle, row in zip(read_set.members, rows):
 260:                 actual = self.primitives.identity(handle)
 261:                 self.identities_checked += 1
 262:                 self.observed_identities.append(_identity_row(actual))
 263:                 _require(actual == row[2], "inherited_file_identity_mismatch")
 264:                 read_set.identities.append(actual)
 265:             self.assets = tuple(BufferAsset(row[0], row[4], row[3], handle)
 266:                                 for handle, row in zip(read_set.members, rows))
 267:             self.status = "adopted"
 268:             return self
 269:         except BaseException:
 270:             self.status = "refused"
 271:             if self.read_set is not None:
 272:                 self.read_set.unconfirmed = True
 273:             raise
 274: 
 275:     def materialize_generated(self):
 276:         _require(self.status == "adopted" and not self.materialization_started, "adoption_before_readback")
 277:         self.materialization_started = True
 278:         try:
 279:             self.namespace = PinnedBufferNamespace(self.primitives, self.read_set, self.assets, PAYLOAD_BYTES).materialize()
 280:             _require(self.namespace.namespace_sha256 == namespace_digest(), "complete_generated_namespace_digest")
 281:             for name in NAMES:
 282:                 _require(self.namespace.lookup(name) == GENERATED[name], "generated_complete_byte_readback")
 283:             self.status = "materialized"
 284:             return {"namespace_sha256": namespace_digest(), "payload_bytes": PAYLOAD_BYTES,
 285:                     "members": [{"name": name, "bytes": len(GENERATED[name]),
 286:                                  "sha256": hashlib.sha256(GENERATED[name]).hexdigest()} for name in NAMES]}
 287:         except BaseException:
 288:             self.status = "refused"
 289:             self.read_set.unconfirmed = True
 290:             raise
 291: 
 292:     def materialize_admitted(self, payload_budget=None):
 293:         _require(self.status == "adopted" and not self.materialization_started, "adoption_before_readback")
 294:         _require(self.read_set is not None and not self.read_set.unconfirmed and not self.read_set.released,
 295:                  "read_set_not_live")
 296:         _require(self.assets is not None and len(self.assets) in (4, 5), "complete_asset_schema")
 297:         budget = sum(asset.size for asset in self.assets) if payload_budget is None else payload_budget
 298:         self.materialization_started = True
 299:         try:
 300:             self.namespace = PinnedBufferNamespace(self.primitives, self.read_set, self.assets, budget).materialize()
 301:             for asset in self.assets:
 302:                 _require(self.namespace.lookup(asset.name) is not None, "admitted_member_lookup")
 303:             self.status = "materialized"
 304:             return self.namespace
 305:         except BaseException:
 306:             self.status = "refused"
 307:             self.read_set.unconfirmed = True
 308:             raise
 309: 
 310:     def release_after_reads(self):
 311:         _require(self.status == "materialized" and self.read_set is not None and not self.read_set.unconfirmed,
 312:                  "only_successful_readback_can_release")
 313:         # No worker belongs to this child-local set and all synchronous reads
 314:         # have returned. The parent guards remain held through actual exit.
 315:         result = self.primitives.release_read_set(self.read_set)
 316:         _require(result is True and self.read_set.released, "child_read_guard_release_unconfirmed")
 317:         self.status = "released"
 318:         return True
 319: 
 320:     def receipt(self):
 321:         return {"status": self.status, "owned_members": len(self.read_set.members) if self.read_set else 0,
 322:                 "inheritance_cleared": self.inheritance_cleared, "identities_checked": self.identities_checked,
 323:                 "observed_identities": list(self.observed_identities),
 324:                 "materialization_started": self.materialization_started,
 325:                 "materialized_namespace_sha256": self.namespace.namespace_sha256 if self.namespace else None,
 326:                 "read_set_unconfirmed": self.read_set.unconfirmed if self.read_set else None,
 327:                 "read_set_released": self.read_set.released if self.read_set else False,
 328:                 "handles_closed": [handle.closed for handle in self.read_set.members] if self.read_set else [],
 329:                 "complete_native_namespace_protection": False, "model_calls": 0}
